'''''The Glove of Darth Vader''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] junior novel written by [[Paul Davids]] and [[Hollace Davids]], with interior art by [[Karl Kesel]]. It is the first volume of the informally named "[[Adventures of a Jedi Prince|Jedi Prince]]" series, and it was followed by ''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]''. It was first published in paperback by [[Bantam Spectra|Bantam Skylark]] in [[July]] [[1992]], and it was later collected in the hardcover compilation ''[[Star Wars: Book One]]'' ([[1997]]).
